decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (BP/SR/dsb/ -01, -02, -03, -04, -05, -06.  Received:  21/05/2010)   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 99 Southville Road, Feltham.
Condition : 5 - No additional openings shall be formed in the elevationsl of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and a single storey rear extension
